about: Nameless locals for small talk when Ishai is out (never at home): one moment each, no memory, never back by name. Read by the worker (validate, the story prompt's LOCALS line, outing goals) and the page (their looks, names and voices). 'at' = the story places they can be found; 'g' = voice gender; 'look' uses the look menu (see CLAUDE.md, Looks).

local-tourist.name: Tourist
local-tourist.role: a sunburnt tourist with a paper map, asking the way and asking what is good to eat

local-grandpa.name: Old Man
local-grandpa.role: a retired man who has an opinion on the weather, the buses and the government, and a story about 1973

local-mom.name: Young Mom
local-mom.role: a tired, funny mother pushing a stroller, glad to talk to any adult

local-vendor.name: Vendor
local-vendor.role: a loud Shuk Shalom vendor who calls everyone 'motek' and gives a taste of everything

local-clerk.name: Shop Clerk
local-clerk.role: a bored shop clerk who perks up for a real conversation

local-student.name: Student
local-student.role: a university student with too many tote bags and an exam tomorrow

local-jogger.name: Jogger
local-jogger.role: a jogger catching her breath, very serious about her running app

local-dogman.name: Dog Walker
local-dogman.role: a man walking a tiny nervous dog who talks about the dog as if it were a person

local-savta.name: Grandma
local-savta.role: a grandmother with a shopping trolley who has advice for him about everything

local-guy.name: Guy Next Table
local-guy.role: a chatty man at the next table who reads the news out loud and wants a second opinion
